title: SINAMICS S120 Drive Functions — Servo Control and Controller Optimization
locator: Section 4.12 Optimizing current and speed controller; speed controller frequency response measurement and resonance/current-setpoint filters
notes: SINAMICS S120-specific controller optimization documentation. It illustrates use of frequency-response measurements to locate resonances and adjust current-setpoint filters, followed by gain/integral-time optimization. Values and procedures are specific to the stated drive generation/firmware and must not be transplanted to other drives or machines.
